description.text: Both the full-time program (all English) and part-time program (bi-lingual) last two years, aiming at cultivating forward-looking and innovative business leaders with financial expertise. More than just finance, what you get here is also a strong network of alumni to support your career. Whatever your prior profession is, SAIF paves your way towards the financial world. The faculty of SAIF's full-time Finance MBA program consists of world-class professors from top business schools. Apart from delivering you state-of-the-art financial knowledge, SAIF also builds for you a strong network of alumni to support your career. Tuition fee Students from Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan: Full-time program: RMB 168,000 for 2 years Part-time program: RMB 238,000 for 2 years International students: Full-time & Part-time: RMB 238, 000 for 2 years Miscellaneous Expenses Books, Course Materials & Recreation: Approx.100 RMB per course Scholarship now available for international students: The Laureate Award – Full cover age of tuition fee 1 MBA student The Premium Award – Half coverage of tuition fee 2 MBA students Why choose SAIF Fiance MBA? SAIF Finance MBA program aims to help those who want to pursue a successful career in finance. Whatever your prior profession is, SAIF paves your way towards the financial world with: Worldwide gurus of finance, with expertise in both western and Chinese markets; Advanced curriculum in Finance, furthering your know-how; Virtual trading practice based on real-time stock fluctuations; A gathering of talented human capital, leads to the exchange of brilliant minds; Not Just Finance --- also covering other relevant subjects; Growing value of your degree, with the rapid growth of SAIF and Chinese financial markets; Tailor-made career service.

duration.text: The Finance MBA in English at Shanghai Advanced Institute of Finance is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 16527 USD/per year ￥ 119000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Academic transcript of highest education 6.Two letters of reference One from associate professor and above, one from previous employer 7.Resume Written in Chinese or in English 8.GMAT or GRE certificate Authorized Copy of GMAT certificate with score of 550 or GRE certificate with score of 1100 or above within the period of validity of 5 years.

requirements.text: Bachelor’s degree or above GMAT>550/ GRE>1100 3-year working experience after obtaining bachelor’s degree or 2-year working experience after obtaining master’s degree
